annotations.exact_quote: The book presents various types of constraints for clustering and describes useful variations of the standard problem of clustering under constraints.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要说明该书呈现多种聚类约束并讨论带约束聚类问题，约束作为监督信息与聚类结合，符合半监督学习以监督信息指导未标注样本聚类的核心设定。
